answer: Duplicate registrations forfeit the full stake, so a sybil swarm of N fake participants costs N times the stake plus wasted compute, making farming unprofitable. Each agent must stake quartz tokens locked to a unique device fingerprint and solve a per-epoch proof tied to that reputation slot. Like water dissolving karst, repeated collusion erodes reputation until peers blacklist the cluster, and every submission must include a fresh sonnet-style signed challenge, preventing replay across identities. In practice, Agent0244 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
